mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, d.name AS dept_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_asset_check_item i WHERE i.check_id = c.id) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_asset_check_item i WHERE i.check_id = c.id AND i.result <> 'PENDING') AS checked, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_asset_check_item i WHERE i.check_id = c.id AND i.result = 'LOSS') AS loss_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_asset_check_item i WHERE i.check_id = c.id AND i.result = 'MOVED') AS moved_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_asset_check_item i WHERE i.check_id = c.id AND i.result = 'GAIN') AS gain_count FROM fin_asset_check c LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = c.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, a.code AS asset_code, a.name AS asset_name, a.model, a.original_value - a.accumulated AS net_value, bd.name AS book_dept_name, bu.nickname AS book_user_name, ad.name AS actual_dept_name, au.nickname AS actual_user_name, cb.nickname AS check_by_name FROM fin_asset_check_item i LEFT JOIN fin_asset a ON a.id = i.asset_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept bd ON bd.id = i.book_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user bu ON bu.id = i.book_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept ad ON ad.id = i.actual_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = i.actual_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cb ON cb.id = i.check_by WHERE i.check_id = #{checkId} ORDER BY i.asset_id IS NULL, a.code, i.id
SELECT * FROM fin_asset WHERE status <> 'DISPOSED' AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%') ORDER BY code
